status: Post hoc mechanistic analysis planned before 400-run calculation; one engineering run was inspected to verify reconstruction. No external preregistration.
panel: All400 normal_evaluation runs from independent-stream confirmation; all960 observations per run; identical original frozen52-variable affine monitor.
recovery: Replay saved Philox random-call schedule only; no ODE integration or new process trajectory. Recover CI and native noise using their own event IDs and initialization masks.
primary_estimand: Pooled unbiased sample score variance over400x960 points; bootstrap units are400 independent physical runs.
variable_difference: post-minus-CI measurement difference = noise difference + noiseless recorded signal difference; pooled variance includes twice covariance. Units normalized by original measurement noise SD squared. Report all41 channels; spotlight10 flows and2levels. Channel decomposition uses ddof0 to match current TableS1; both original squared units and noise-SD-normalized units are reported. Score variance retains ddof1.
endpoint_decomposition: Exact six-block contributions to beta-transformed covariance difference between actual post and same-time rho0, groups C1:22/A23:41/U42:52.
common_noise_bridge: rho0 + beta times noiseless recorded signal difference, separatelycontinuous/analyzers/all and XMEAS17. Exact pooled variance telescoping with signed covariance allocation; descriptive counterfactual only.

bootstrap.method: paired whole-run percentile95%, pooled variance recomputed each replicate using run means and within-run centered crossproducts; marginal intervals conditional on fixed model and existing noise realization

constraints: Never treat record points as independent inferential units
Group substitution toCI is not direct attribution of post-minus-rho0
All covariance terms retained; no renormalizing each arm
Code and existing data remain unchanged
provenance_note: ddof0 table convention was confirmed from current SI before aggregation; original data and monitor are unchanged.
